_provenance.description: Per-model USD rates per 1,000,000 tokens (USD/MTok). Adapter-owned: lib/adapters/*.js price(slice) reads this table and multiplies slice.usage.by_model token counts by the matching rates. The daemon NEVER reads this file — it only sums the dollar subtotals the adapters compute (see docs/adapter-contract.md, Usage accounting contract).
_provenance.fields: Each model entry: input, output, cache_read, cache_write — USD per 1M tokens. cache_write/cache_creation may be omitted for providers that do not bill it separately (treated as 0).
sources: Anthropic pricing: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing (Claude API). Cache read ~= 0.1x input; cache write (5m) ~= 1.25x input.
OpenAI pricing: https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing (gpt-5-codex / gpt-4o / o-series). OpenAI bills cached input at a reduced rate and does not separately bill cache writes.
_provenance.review: RATES NEED PERIODIC REVIEW — these are published list prices as of as_of and will drift. Correct the numbers here (an edit, not a release). Structure/keys are the contract; exact values are advisory.
_provenance.matching: Adapters match a by_model model id to a key by longest-prefix (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8-20260514' matches 'claude-opus-4'). Unknown model -> cost stays 0, no crash.
